# Validate inputs
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Each input must be a 2D numpy array")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Input arrays must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Input log probabilities must be nonpositive")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
